priya: heads up — onboarding a new HF model (gpt-ish) using a jinja-based chat_template. after conversion the Redwood prompt loses the sentinel markers and kv-cache padding seems to shift role boundaries. reproducer below.

priya: original jinja template (simplified) — note the sentinel tokens we expect: 
```jinja
{% if system %}
- role: system
  content: \"{{ system }}\"
{% endif %}
{% for m in messages %}
- role: \"{{ m.role }}\"
  content: \"{{ m.content }}\"
{% endfor %}
```

priya: rendered example we expect (explicit sentinels):
```text
<|system|>System priming here<|endofmessage|>
<|user|>User: hi<|endofmessage|>
<|assistant|>Assistant: hello<|endofmessage|>
```

priya: actual converted Redwood prompt (what the converter produced):
```text
System priming here
User: hi
Assistant: hello
```

priya: this causes two problems: 1) special tokens like <|system|> were removed (they're in tokenizer.additional_special_tokens in HF config) and 2) when we reuse KV cache the per-message token padding (model packs to multiples of 8) shifts offsets, so role prefixes end up concatenating into previous messages during streaming.

alex: can you paste the model's config.json + tokenizer config? conversion scripts usually miss tokenizer.add_special_tokens calls.

marco: also check that the converter doesn't coalesce empty blocks — if system == \"\" the jinja path sometimes emits a blank line which the converter then strips, dropping the sentinel entirely. packing/pad behavior then changes alignment.

onboard-bot: conversion-run-2026-02-15T12:33Z tool=v2.3 - jinja->rw - applied rewrite rule \"loop_to_concat\" - removed special_tokens: [\"<|system|>\"] - suggestion: run with preserve_special_tokens=true

jen: fyi quantization (int8) won't change tokenization, but combined with packing heuristics it can change how many pad tokens we append per batch, which explains the offset appearing only in dedicated/dense quantized runs. try disabling kv-cache to confirm.

priya: confirmed — disabling kv-cache removes the role-bleed in streaming. so it's definitely a padding/alignment issue interacting with missing sentinels. plan: update converter to inject explicit role sentinels (e.g. <|role:system|>) before each message AND call tokenizer.add_special_tokens([...]) then persist the tokenizer.json. will run the eval harness after.

alex: can you paste the small repro call? would be helpful to rerun locally.

priya: repro command we used: 
```bash
# conversion call that produced the broken prompt
python tools/convert_jinja.py --template=policy.jinja --out=prompt.txt --preserve-sentinels=false
```

marco: try this instead: 
```bash
python tools/convert_jinja.py --template=policy.jinja --out=prompt.txt --preserve-sentinels=true \
  --special-tokens '["<|system|>","<|user|>","<|assistant|>"]'
```

priya: will try that and run evals: evals/role-bleed/bench-1 (latency + quality) and share results here. thanks :thumbsup:

jen: if you want pairing time, ping me — @priya :phone: 

onboard-bot: scheduled job created: conversion-run-1819032468-alloc (will run preserve-sentinels=true)

priya: updating the converter patch now, will dump the before/after prompts and tokenized offsets in this thread when done.

alex: nice, thanks for the quick triage. :shipit:
